description: Source code for a macOS SwiftUI application that implements a web chat interface, including transport mechanisms, window management, and UI presentation logic.

classes.name: WebChatSwiftUIWindowController
classes.description: Manages the macOS window or panel displaying the web chat UI, including show, close, reposition, and presentation behaviors.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Requests chat history for a given session key.

methods.name: listModels
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available chat models.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing chat run based on session and run IDs.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists chat sessions with optional limit.

methods.name: setSessionModel
methods.description: Sets the model for a specific chat session.

methods.name: setSessionThinking
methods.description: Updates the thinking level of a chat session.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message within a chat session with optional attachments and thinking state.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status of the connection.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Streams real-time chat events from the server.
